issue.title: ensure custom cache handlers are preloaded
issue.body:
### What
When specifying a custom "use cache" handler via `experimental.cacheHandlers`, the handler is not used during `next start`

### Why
Custom cache handlers are initialized after the first request in `getIncrementalCache`. But because `unstable_preloadEntries` is the default during `next start`, we won't have loaded the custom cache handlers and the app will be stuck using the default cache handler once its set on the global namespace.

### How
This updates `unstable_preloadEntries` to load any custom cache handlers so they're used instead of the default. 

Fixes #72552
